title: Discs Plus
description: This mod adds 9 minecraft records that you can listen to or listen to on older versions. But this mod fixes this and now you can listen to the minecraft soundtrack on the records. In the next updates, I will add the ability to craft records.
body:
This mod adds discs from the old Minecraft. The mod will be updated with discs every week. At the moment, there are only discs from the old Minecraft in fashion, but there will be more. 

To get the discs, you need to get them from the creative (we'll fix this for crafting in the next update)

There are 9 records
- Aria Math
- Wet Hands
- Sweden
- Subwoofer Lullaby
- Moog City
- Minecraft
- Mice on Venus
- Haggstrom
- Dreiton
All of them were performed by C418
